description: Implementation of the NetworkDelegateImpl class methods for handling network request events and policies in Chromium project.

classes.name: NetworkDelegateImpl
classes.description: Implements network request delegate methods for handling URL requests, headers, cookies, privacy, and reporting policies.

methods.name: OnBeforeURLRequest
methods.description: Called before a URL request is made; currently returns OK.

methods.name: OnBeforeStartTransaction
methods.description: Called before starting a transaction; currently returns OK.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when headers are received; currently returns OK.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Called when response starts; empty implementation.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Called when request completes; empty implementation.

methods.name: OnURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Called when URL request is destroyed; empty implementation.

methods.name: OnPACScriptError
methods.description: Handles PAC script errors; empty implementation.

methods.name: OnAnnotateAndMoveUserBlockedCookies
methods.description: Annotates and moves user-blocked cookies; returns true.

methods.name: OnCanSetCookie
methods.description: Checks if a cookie can be set; returns true.

methods.name: OnCancelURLRequestWithPolicyViolatingReferrerHeader
methods.description: Handles URL request cancellation due to referrer policy; returns false.

methods.name: OnCanQueueReportingReport
methods.description: Checks if reporting report can be queued; returns true.

methods.name: OnCanSendReportingReports
methods.description: Handles sending reporting reports; runs callback with origins.

methods.name: OnCanSetReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if reporting client can be set; returns true.

methods.name: OnCanUseReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if reporting client can be used; returns true.

methods.name: OnGetFirstPartySetsCacheFilterMatchInfoMaybeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cache filter match info asynchronously; returns default info.
